title: A community plant swap
passage: Bring up to three labelled plants, but no glass pots. Two eligible plants earn early entry; everyone else enters at eleven. In rain, use the gym door, not the garden gate. Volunteers check labels at the open entrance. At twelve noon, volunteers send unclaimed plants to the library's gardening club. Plants with a return tag stay at the volunteer table. Give a volunteer your name before leaving to get that tag.
passageZh: 最多可帶三盆貼好標籤的植物，但不收玻璃盆。帶兩盆合格植物才可提早入場，其他人十一點入場。下雨時不要走花園大門，請改走體育館入口。志工會在開放的入口檢查標籤。中午十二點，志工會把沒被領走的植物送到圖書館的園藝社。有退還標籤的植物會留在志工桌。請在離開前向志工告知你的名字，才能取得這張標籤。
